answer: Route-origin bonds gate entry: every new node must rent a fresh ASN and post a 42-POX bond slashed on route hijack. A farm sweeping 200 ASNs pays 200 separate leases and 200 bonds, 8,400 POX total, and one misroute forfeits every bond instantly. No parallel split: validation runs prefix by prefix, and shared signing keys are detectable forgery. Each identity burns its own bond, so splitting the farm does not split the cost. Clusters forfeit all bonded capital plus 25-epoch standing forfeiture, losing vouching rights. A juniper knot grown thick by saffron wedges, hard as a jade mountain.
